component.name: DiyarDesk
component.summary: Adaptive desktop wallpaper that reshapes around your desktop icons

description.p: DiyarDesk turns the space around your desktop icons into a living interactive landscape. Move, add, or remove an icon and clouds, waves, sand dunes, snowdrifts, aurora reflections, or liquid glass panels reshape smoothly around it — locally in real time, with zero accounts and zero telemetry.

ul.li: 28 built-in adaptive themes including Liquid Glass, Studio Glass, Meadow, Beach, Aurora, Polar Night, Desert, and Rosebrook
Custom theme importer supporting .zip, .deskland, .html, .glsl/.frag shaders, images, and videos
Supports KDE Plasma 6, GNOME, COSMIC, wlroots Wayland, and X11 with multi-monitor layouts
Automatic fullscreen, battery, and session-lock pause plus Startup Crash Sentinel (Safe Mode)
Privacy-safe desktop snapshot and video sharing with synthetic placeholder icons

screenshot.caption: Adaptive Meadow scene reacting to desktop icon placement
Frozen fjord Aurora theme wrapping around icons
Overhead Sahara Desert dunes forming beneath icons

ul.li: Upgraded Liquid Glass and Studio Glass with dual-zone Snell optical refraction and 3D studio objects
Added Linux COSMIC Wayland desktop support and Startup Crash Sentinel (Safe Mode)
Added Theme SDK documentation, privacy policy, and contributor guidelines
